verses.en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered and said,
verses.sm: Elifasa le Timanu, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: If we assay to commune with thee, wilt thou be grieved? but who can withhold himself from speaking?
verses.sm: A taumafai atu se upu ia te oe, pe e te tiga ai ca? A o ai se na te mafaia ona taofi lana upu?

verses.en: Behold, thou hast instructed many, and thou hast strengthened the weak hands.
verses.sm: Faauta mai, na e apoapoai atu i tagata e toatele, na e faamalosia lima vaivai.

verses.en: Thy words have upholden him that was falling, and thou hast strengthened the feeble knees.
verses.sm: O au upu sa faamautuina ai le sa tautevateva, sa e faamalosia foi tulivae sa vaivai.

verses.en: But now it is come upon thee, and thou faintest; it toucheth thee, and thou art troubled.
verses.sm: A o lenei, ua oo mai ia te oe, ua e faavaival ai; ua papai mai ia te oe, ua e atuatuvale ai.

verses.en: Is not this thy fear, thy confidence, thy hope, and the uprightness of thy ways?
verses.sm: O lou faatuatuaga, o lou faamoemoega ma le tonu o ou ala, e le o jou mataʻu ea lea i le Atua?

verses.en: Remember, I pray thee, who ever perished, being innocent? or where were the righteous cut off?
verses.sm: Seʻi e manatu, po o ai ea ua fano fua a e le sala? po o fea foi ua faaumatia ai e ua amiotonu?

verses.en: Even as I have seen, they that plow iniquity, and sow wickedness, reap the same.
verses.sm: O laʻu vaai lea, o e ua suatia le agasala, ma luluina le amio leaga, latou te selesele mai ai lava.

verses.en: By the blast of God they perish, and by the breath of his nostrils are they consumed.
verses.sm: E fano i latou i le mapugatamai o le Atua, e faaumatia foi i latou i le manava o ona pogalisu.

verses.en: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
verses.sm: O le tagi o le leona ma le leo o le leona, ma nifo o leona taanoa, ua gáugau lava ia.

verses.en: The old lion perisheth for lack of prey, and the stout lion's whelps are scattered abroad.
verses.sm: Ua fano le leona, aua e leai sana mea e saeia, e faataapeapeina foi le toloai a le leona fafine.

verses.en: Now a thing was secretly brought to me, and mine ear received a little thereof.
verses.sm: Ua faaoo mai faalilolilo se upu ia te au; ua lagona ai foi oʻu taliga nai mea itiiti.

verses.en: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falleth on men,
verses.sm: O mafaufauga i mea e vaaia i le po, ina o moe gagase tagata;

verses.en: Fear came upon me, and trembling, which made all my bones to shake.
verses.sm: ua 00 mai ai ia te au le mataʻu ma le gatete, na tetemu ai oʻu ivi uma.

verses.en: Then a spirit passed before my face; the hair of my flesh stood up:
verses.sm: Na ui ane i oʻu luma le agaga, ua mátatili ai loʻu tino.

verses.en: It stood still, but I could not discern the form thereof: an image was before mine eyes, there was silence, and I heard a voice, saying,
verses.sm: Na tu mai o ia, a ou te lei iloa le uiga O lona tino mai; sa i ai le ata i luma o oʻu mata, sa ligoligo, ona ou faalogo ai lea i le leo,

verses.en: Shall mortal man be more just than God? shall a man be more pure than his maker?
verses.sm: Pe sili ea le amiotonu a le tagata i lo le Atua? pe sili ea le lelei o le tagata i le na faia O ia?

verses.en: Behold, he put no trust in his servants; and his angels he charged with folly:
verses.sm: Faauta, ua le faalagolago o ia i ana auauna; ua ia ta‘uvaleleaina ana agelu.

verses.en: How much less in them that dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, which are crushed before the moth?
verses.sm: E atili ai ona faapea i e o nonofo i fale omea, o i ai lo latou faavae i le eleele, ua tu'imomomoina i latou e pei o le pepe.

verses.en: They are destroyed from morning to evening: they perish for ever without any regarding it.
verses.sm: E tu‘imomomoina i latou e afua i le taeao e 00 i le afiafi, ua fano i latou e faavavau ma le le manatua e se tasi.

verses.en: Doth not their excellency which is in them go away? they die, even without wisdom.
verses.sm: Ua le avea ea lo latou faasilisili sa ia te i latou? Ua oti i latou, a o le popoto.
